The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas resulting in #NAME? errors in the statistics section.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError in /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, cells H46 through L47 returned #NAME? instead of the expected floating-point values (e.g., H46 expected -3.5737762237762265). This indicates that the generated Excel formulas use undefined names, unsupported functions, or incorrect syntax that openpyxl or the verifier cannot resolve. Avoid using complex named ranges or non-standard functions without ensuring they are correctly defined in the workbook scope.
